note: Which open coverage issue closes the files of each measured area (docs/testing/COVERAGE.md, Measured line and branch coverage). scripts/coverage/coverage-docs.mjs reads it to account for every file below 100% line and branch in coverage-gaps.md. Re-point an area here when its issue changes.
